title: Implicit transverse coordinates and regular coefficient calculus
statement:
Let $k$ have characteristic zero and let $B$ be smooth of finite type over $k$, with an etale coordinate chart $(w_1,\ldots,w_m,y_1,\ldots,y_r)$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Let regular functions $h_1,\ldots,h_r$ vanish at $a$ and have invertible $y$-Jacobian there. After restricting to its nonvanishing locus, $N=V(h_1,\ldots,h_r)$ is smooth, and $w$ is an etale coordinate system on $N$. At every $b\in N$, put $L=\kappa(b)$. In the Taylor ring there is a unique vector $\phi_b(W)\in(W)L[[W]]^r$ solving $h_b(W,\phi_b(W))=0$, and
$$h_b(W,Y)=U_b(W,Y)(Y-\phi_b(W))$$
with $U_b$ an invertible formal matrix [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. The substitution $Y=\phi_b(W)+Z$ is an invertible continuous change of variables and identifies the extended ideal of $N$ with $(Z)$. Coordinate derivations of regular functions in an etale chart remain regular and commute with Taylor expansion [def-trf-formal-power-series-partial-derivative]. More generally, for any family $F=\sum_\gamma c_\gamma(w,y)T^\gamma$ with regular coefficients and finitely many formal variables $T$, the coefficient of $Z^\delta T^\gamma$ after this substitution is the Taylor expansion on $N$ of $(\partial_y^\delta c_\gamma)|_N/\delta!$. These formulas commute with residue-field extension. The local Taylor map from a smooth chart to $L[[W,Y]]$ is faithfully flat, also at nonclosed points; consequently equality of extended finitely generated ideals implies equality of their stalk ideals, and equality of stalks of two coherent ideals extends to a neighbourhood.
